post.caption: Richard Burton set out to buy a big pear shaped diamond at a New York auction in October 1969 and told his bidders to stop at $1 million. Cartier won with $1,050,000, $50,000 more than his limit, and Burton then bought it from Cartier for $1.1 million. The finished diamond weighs 69.42 carats and began as a rough stone of about 241 carats found in 1966. Elizabeth Taylor wore it first as a ring, then as a necklace, and part of the money when she sold it helped fund a hospital in Botswana.
